source: This distinction becomes important in ZXNAME0000XZ, ZXNAME0001XZ, transposes, reductions, and many fused kernels. The kernel writer is deciding which intermediates deserve predictable on-chip residence rather than hoping a cache replacement policy keeps them around.
zh: 这种区别在 ZXNAME0000XZ、ZXNAME0001XZ、转置、归约和许多融合内核中变得很重要。内核编写者正在决定哪些中间体值得在片上进行可预测的驻留，而不是希望缓存替换策略将它们保留下来。
